title: Harbor Light Industrial BOV
summary: Sample Coastal Brokerage values Harbor Light Industrial at $11,300,000–$12,100,000, most likely $11,700,000, and recommends listing at $11,950,000.

evidence.quote: Prepared by Sample Coastal Brokerage for Model Fund I Harbor Light LLC.
This opinion of value is dated November 2, 2026.
We estimate the market value of Harbor Light Industrial at between $11,300,000 and $12,100,000.
We estimate the market value of Harbor Light Industrial at between $11,300,000 and $12,100,000.
That value is $325 per square foot.
The most likely value reflects a 5.60% cap rate on in-place net operating income.
We recommend a list price of $11,950,000.
Our proposed listing fee is 1.00% of the sale price.
We expect a marketing period of ten weeks from launch to a call for offers.
